responsibility: Implements the source-file scanner that feeds the parser with normalized Fortran characters and line maps. It loads whole files into memory, handles continuation lines, preprocessing output, include handling, source-form tracking, wide-character conversions, and file/location bookkeeping so later matching code can work over a clean token stream.
same_name_distinction: Implements the scanner itself: it owns the include/module path globals declared in scanner.h and performs file loading, preprocessing-line handling, include processing, wide-character conversion, line buffering, and source-location tracking. The same-name header only defines the directory-list type and extern declarations for those shared path lists.
